program_name: Diploma in Medical and Health Science

fees.notes: StudyMalaysia course page: international fees RM80,475. MSU official programme pages publish Malaysian fees only; no official international fee schedule available. Source: https://studymalaysia.com/what/course/MSU/0058669/ (accessed 2026-09-18).

requirements.general: SPM or Equivalent Qualifications: Pass SPM or its equivalent with at least FIVE (5) Credits: Compulsory: Bahasa Malaysia TWO (2) from Mathematics and Science subjects (Biology, Chemistry, General Science, or Applied Science) TWO (2) from any other subjects A Pass in English is required; preference for Credit GCE O-Level: At least FIVE (5) Credits: TWO (2) from Mathematics and Science (Biology, Physics, Chemistry, General Science) THREE (3) other subjects Pass in English required Health & Medical Certification: Medically certified fit by a registered practitioner recognized by MSU Must be free from: mental illness, physical/sensory disability, infectious diseases (e.g., HIV/AIDS, Hepatitis B/C), genetic disorders, epilepsy, substance abuse
